candidates.name: Peacock-Blue Fine-Knit Crew
candidates.decisionReason: The fine peacock-blue color is useful, but original-resolution review shows a close chest and narrow sleeve line that recreates the fitted skinny-top silhouette explicitly excluded.

candidates.name: Mustard Half-Zip Knit
candidates.decisionReason: The mustard color is cheerful, but the plain performance-style half zip, synthetic surface and basic straight body read outdoor base layer rather than a modern Party knit.

candidates.name: Green and Oatmeal Argyle Knit
candidates.decisionReason: The red-green argyle is expressive, but the extremely oversized fuzzy body, balloon sleeves and Christmas-like palette look costume-heavy rather than clean Zara-led evening styling.

candidates.name: Peacock-Blue Mock-Neck Knit
candidates.decisionReason: The isolated product image has no on-body fit proof and is digitally shaped into a visibly tight chest and narrow waist, making it unsafe for the regular-proportion brief.

candidates.name: White Cable-Knit Turtleneck
candidates.decisionReason: The product-only cable turtleneck provides no body proof and its narrow torso and sleeves appear fitted; white alone cannot justify a Winter Party approval.

candidates.name: Camel Cable-Knit Quarter Zip
candidates.decisionReason: Full-resolution body proof shows a close torso and narrow sleeves, while the camel cable quarter zip reads conventional and dated rather than fresh Party styling.

candidates.name: Army-Green Pleated Corduroy Trouser
candidates.decisionReason: The product-only corduroy has no on-body drape proof and combines deep front pleats, a balloon-taper leg, rolled cuffs and a D-ring utility detail; it risks exactly the baggy bottom problem.

candidates.name: Light-Gray Straight Washed Jean
candidates.decisionReason: The light gray wash is useful, but the very broad leg stacks and puddles heavily over chunky sneakers, making the jean too baggy and Casual for the requested Party line.

candidates.name: Dark Zip-Detail Straight Jean
candidates.decisionReason: The dark washed jean has hem stacking, zipper hardware and a black-heavy presentation; it would return the scenario to the repetitive dark nightclub styling the user rejected.

candidates.name: Nostalgic-Blue Straight Jean
candidates.decisionReason: The pale nostalgic wash is too summery and the long loose leg visibly puddles over the shoe, producing a baggy streetwear silhouette rather than Winter Party polish.

candidates.name: Blue-Gray Relaxed Jean
candidates.decisionReason: The jean is dark, heavily whiskered and styled with rolled cuffs and work boots; its tapered rugged look reads dated outdoor Casual rather than Night Out.
